findings.description: Optional arguments with already bracketed type metavars now receive a second pair of brackets in help output.
findings.rationale: For an optional argument using click.Choice(['a', 'b']), the type supplies the metavar '[a|b]'. Unconditionally wrapping every optional argument changes the displayed usage to '[[a|b]]', introducing redundant brackets into user-facing help.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'already_bracketed|def get_metavar|class Argument|def make_metavar' src/click/core.py src/click/types.py; rg -n '\\[.*\\]|metavar' tests/test_arguments.py | tail -50"
